description.value: Sage Pub & Liquor Store is a combined full-service pub and liquor store in Osoyoos, BC, in the heart of the Okanagan cycling corridor. The pub offers a wide dine-in and takeout menu spanning hand-made pizzas, chicken wings, ribs, poutine, and entrées, alongside weekly events such as trivia nights and karaoke. The attached liquor store operates daily, making it a convenient stop for touring cyclists looking to resupply or sit down for a hot meal after a ride.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record tags this location as a liquor store (shop=alcohol) named 'Sage Liquor Store,' but the website at sagepub.ca clearly identifies the business as 'Sage Pub & Liquor Store' — a full-service pub and restaurant with an attached liquor store at 6403 Cottonwood Drive, Osoyoos, BC. The website confirms active operations with upcoming events in May–June 2026 and supplies contact details (address, phone) absent from OSM. No bike infrastructure (racks, pump, e-bike charging) or water refill is mentioned anywhere on the site; takeout/delivery and gluten-free/vegetarian menu items are explicitly present.
concerns: OSM name is 'Sage Liquor Store' but the business trades as 'Sage Pub & Liquor Store' per the website — the OSM record undersells the pub component and may confuse cyclists expecting only a liquor store.
OSM tagged only as shop=alcohol; the business is primarily a pub/restaurant with an attached liquor store, so the category and tags are incomplete.
Phone and address are absent from OSM; values here are sourced solely from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A full-service pub with takeout, a daily-open liquor store, and a food-forward menu makes this a practical and appealing stop for touring cyclists passing through Osoyoos. Bike-specific infrastructure is unconfirmed but the core food-and-drink service is well-evidenced.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Gluten-free pizza crust available (10"); menu includes Vegetarian pizza and a Veggie Platter
